name: ANYTOWN MURAL & SIGN LLC (Michael Ferrarell)
statement:
Michael Ferrarell is Chicago-based muralist and sign painter whose artistic practice focuses heavily on site-responsive aesthetics. His hand painted visual narratives demonstrate a unique sense of past and present, celebrating various elements of heritage, nostalgia, natural beauty, industry, community, and civic pride.
 Ferrarell has a sincere passion for creating murals that render diverse communities through a variety of found texts, patterns, and illustrations inspired by historic and nostalgic imagery, as well as the various people who occupy or frequent the space. This unique exercise of combining localized elements, synonymous with nostalgia and community, is Ferrarell's genuine attempt at connecting with a broad range of locals while simultaneously educating them and visitors alike. His intentions are to stimulate community engagement and spark creative growth through imagery that's not just aesthetically pleasing, but also educational and emphasizes distinct local energy.
 You can find Ferrarell's mural and sign work being celebrated across the United States where he continues to collaborate and connect with communities that share the same philosophy in using art as a tool to educate, honor, and preserve in an aesthetically pleasing manner that's easily accessible to the greater region and beyond.
